MULTIPORT FUEL INJECTION (MFI) <3.0L ENGINE>
13B-235
STEP 2. Using scan tool MB991502, check data list item 81: 
Long - Term Fuel Compensation (trim) Bank 1.
(1) Start the engine and run at idle.
(2) Set scan tool MB991502 to the data reading mode for item 
81, Long − Term Fuel Compensation (trim) Bank 1.
• The fuel trim should be between -12.5 and +12.5 when 
the load is 2,500 r/min (during closed loop) after the 
engine is warmed.
(3) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the specification normal?
YES : Go to Step 3.
NO : Refer to, DTC P0171 − System too Lean (bank 1) 
(P.13B-198), DTC P0172 − System too Rich (bank 1) 
(P.13B-205), DTC P0174 − System too Lean (bank 2) 
(P.13B-210), DTC P0175 − System too Rich (bank 2) 
(P.13B-215).
STEP 3. Using scan tool MB991502, check data list item 82: 
Short - Term Fuel Compensation (trim) Bank 1.
(1) Start the engine and run at idle.
(2) Set scan tool MB991502 to the data reading mode for item 
82, Short − Term Fuel Compensation (trim) Bank 1.
• The fuel trim should be between -25 and +25 when the 
load is 2,500 r/min (during closed loop) after the engine 
is warmed.
(3) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the specification normal?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Refer to, DTC P0171 − System too Lean (bank 1) 
(P.13B-198), DTC P0172 − System too Rich (bank 1) 
(P.13B-205), DTC P0174 − System too Lean (bank 2) 
(P.13B-210), DTC P0175 − System too Rich (bank 2) 
(P.13B-215).
STEP 4. Check the ignition coil spark
(1) Check each ignition coil spark.
(2) Remove the intake manifold.
(3) Remove the spark plug and connect to the spark plug 
cable.
(4) Ground the spark plug side electrode securely.
• When the engine is cranked, the spark plug should 
spark.
Q: Did it spark?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Go to Step 5.
